question.question: The app runs but every data page hangs because there's no PostgreSQL on this machine. How do you want me to get the database up?

displayOptions.label: Install PostgreSQL via winget
displayOptions.description: I run `winget install PostgreSQL.PostgreSQL` (needs admin elevation), create `pal_db`, run `alembic upgrade head`, then restart the backend. Machine-wide change; takes a few minutes.

displayOptions.label: You already have Postgres somewhere
displayOptions.description: Tell me the connection string or port (WSL, another machine, a different local install, Neon/Supabase URL) and I'll point backend/.env at it and migrate.

displayOptions.label: Portable Postgres, no system install
displayOptions.description: I download the EDB standalone PostgreSQL zip into a project-local folder, initdb a data dir under D:\pal\.pgdata, run it on port 5432 as your user. No service, no admin, easily deleted — but adds an untracked directory to the repo root.

displayOptions.label: Leave it DB-less for now
displayOptions.description: Keep both servers running so you can browse the UI shell and Swagger docs. Any page needing company data will hang. No installs, no file changes.
